anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U30 and U46 have their isolated-side ground pins GND2 (pin 5) tied to the main GND net, and their isolated-side supply pins VCC2 (pin 8) powered from 5V_switched_CAN, which is derived from the non-isolated +5V rail.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN transceivers, the isolated side must use a separate isolated ground and an isolated supply. GND2 should not be connected to main GND, and VCC2 should come from an isolated DC-DC or isolated supply.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation of both CAN buses is defeated, allowing ground loops and removing the isolation protection the design intended. The CAN buses are effectively referenced to the main board ground.

parsed.summary: The design files contain an anomaly: the isolated CAN transceivers U30 and U46 have their isolated-side ground GND2 tied directly to the main GND net, so the CAN buses are not actually isolated as the specification requires.
